blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A purported bagman told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Thursday that he delivered cash-filled suitcases, or “maleta,” to Sen. Vicente “Tito” Sotto III, former Rep. Stella Quimbo, and former Sen. Antonio Trillanes. Trillanes has denied the allegation, while the Inquirer is still awaiting comments from Sotto and Quimbo.
